THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
REVOCATION ORDER UNDER SECTION 39 (1)

BY the Order made under the Proviso (a) to Section 38 of the LandAcquisition Act, (Chapter 460) and published in the GazetteExtraordinary No. 2055/58 dated 26.01.2018 and the land specifiedmore fully in the Order No. 21 of 2018 dated 25.01.2018 was vestedin the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka. But the possessionof the said land has not yet been taken for and on behalf of theDemocratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka. Therefore, I GayanthaKarunatilleke, Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms, byvirtue of powers vested in me under Section 39 (1) of the landAcquisition Act, do hereby revoke the aforesaid Order No. 21 of2018 dated 25.01.2018 published in the Gazette Extra OrdinaryNo. 2055/58 dated 26.01.2018.
Gayantha Karunatilleke,Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms.

My Ref. No.: 4-3/11/2017/UD/183.Divisional Secretary’s No.: DS/GFG/L&L/05/101.Ministry of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms,“Mihikatha Medura”, Land Secretariat,No. 1200/06,Rajamalwatta Road,Battaramulla.21st May, 2019.

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
ORDER UNDER SECTION 39A(1)

THE allotments specified in the Order No. 167 of 2013 madeunder the Proviso (a) to Section 38 of the Land Acquisition Act(Chapter 460) and published in the Gazette ExtraordinaryNo. 1812/7 dated 28th May 2013 is vested absolutely in the State

and the possession of which has been taken for or on behalf of theState under Para (a) of Section 40 of the aforesaid Act. But by thevirtue of power vested in me by Sub section (1) of Section 39 (a)(inserted by Act, No. 08 of 1979) of the land Acquisition Act, IGayantha Karunatilleke, Minister of Lands and ParliamentaryReforms do hereby divest only the allotment described in the Schedule1 below:
Gayantha Karunatilleke,Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms.
